subject: Discovery recap & next steps — rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@globex.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — rotating demo slots

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the technical demo with your engineering and security teams:

- Recap: You’re evaluating multi-region inference for a customer-facing feature (low-latency for EU/US, throughput spikes APAC). Key concerns: warm KV cache persistence, audit logs retention, and predictable cost.
- Ask: For the demo please confirm 1) technical attendees (eng + infra + security) and 2) primary success metrics we should instrument (p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, cache hit rate).

To make coordination easier across the team, we propose rotating the demo time weekly so we cover US/EU/APAC-friendly windows. Below are a set of candidate weekly slots (all times shown with local and UTC equivalents):

Option A — US-friendly week
- Wed 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST / 16:00 UTC

Option B — EU-friendly week
- Thu 14:00 CEST / 13:00 BST / 08:00 ET / 12:00 UTC

Option C — APAC-friendly week
- Fri 16:00 SGT / 13:00 IST / 09:00 CEST / 08:00 UTC

Proposal: Run a 3-week rotating cadence (Week 1: Option A, Week 2: Option B, Week 3: Option C) so everyone gets a reasonably convenient window over the pilot period. If you prefer, we can do a 2-week rotation (US/EU + APAC pool) — flexible on our side.

Please reply with the preferred option or paste 2-3 concrete windows that work for your team next week and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a short discovery agenda and a suggested demo outline.

Attachments: discovery-agenda.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — rotating demo slots

Thanks Marissa — useful recap.

Priya and I discussed quickly. A few constraints from our side:
- Our security lead (joining on the demo) is only available in APAC mornings (Priya is GMT+5:30) and late US afternoons (they start late).
- We’d like the first demo to include a short 10–15m deep-dive on audit/logs and IAM integration.

Concrete windows that work for us next week (your local times would be):
- Tue 08:30 PT / Tue 11:30 ET / Tue 16:00 GMT+5:30 (Priya) — corresponds to Tue 16:00 UTC
- Thu 15:00 PT / Thu 18:00 ET / Fri 04:30 GMT+5:30 (not ideal for Priya) — prefer to avoid
- Fri 09:30 SGT / Fri 01:30 UTC / Thu 18:30 ET — this is our preferred APAC-friendly slot if you can run it late for US folks.

If the rotating cadence works, maybe start with the APAC-friendly week so our security lead can join live for the first run.

On the agenda: Alex Johnson, Priya Singh, Rahul Nair (security), and one backend engineer (TBD).

Alex — thanks for the constraints and the attendee list. A couple of operational notes and a suggested concrete plan from our side: 

1) Rotating cadence: We recommend starting with the APAC-friendly slot so Rahul (security) can join live for the first demo, then rotate weekly: Week 1 APAC, Week 2 EU, Week 3 US. That aligns with your ask and ensures we cover audit/logs early.

2) Proposed first demo (we can confirm the exact date once you pick a day):
- Fri 09:30 SGT / Fri 01:30 UTC / Thu 18:30 ET (60 minutes)
- Draft agenda: 5m intros, 25m demo (latency & cache flows), 15m deep-dive on audit/logs & IAM, 15m Q&A/next steps

3) Calendar and invites: I’ll create a rotating calendar series and share the .ics. Also adding a Zoom link and a short pre-demo checklist for security.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567). I’ve attached a provisional invite (redwood-demo-invite.ics) and the short agenda (discovery-agenda.pdf) again.
